Kheerganga trek (12 km, moderate, from Barsheni)

overview:
The best of Parvati Valley in one long weekend: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening in an AC push-back vehicle and reaches Kasol the next morning.

Day 1 is for Kasol's cafes and market, an evening hike to Chalal village and a bonfire. Day 2 is the Kheerganga trek, 12 km (moderate) from Barsheni, ending with a bonfire dinner and a night in camps under the stars. Day 3 treks down and drives to Tosh village for a guest house night. Day 4 has a short hike to Tosh waterfall before heading back via Kasol; you reach Chandigarh early the next morning and Delhi by noon. Stays, 6 meals, transfers and a tour curator are included. Prices start at ₹8,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Kasol in an AC push-back vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Kasol | Kasol market | Chalal village
itinerary.content:
Reach Kasol by morning and check in.
Explore the Kasol market, try the local cafes or relax by the Parvati River.
Evening hike to Chalal village for Parvati Valley views.
Back to the stay for a bonfire, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga trek | Camping
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and transfer to Barsheni by private vehicle.
Trek 12 km (moderate) to Kheerganga through the heart of Parvati Valley, surrounded by snow-capped mountains.
Reach the campsite for a bonfire dinner under a starry sky.
Overnight stay in camps.

itinerary.title: Trek down to Barsheni | Drive to Tosh
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, trek down to Barsheni.
Drive to Tosh and hike through the village to the guest house.
Dinner and a bonfire.
Overnight stay in Tosh.

itinerary.title: Tosh waterfall | Return to Kasol | Departure
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, hike to the nearby Tosh waterfall and take in the Himalayan views.
Head back down to Kasol and depart for home.
Reach Chandigarh early the next morning and Delhi by noon.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to Kasol in an AC push-back vehicle. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Kasol, Kheerganga & Tosh trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹8,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹9,000 on triple sharing and ₹9,500 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

1 night in Kasol, 1 night in Kheerganga camps and 1 night in a Tosh guest house, 6 meals (3 breakfasts and 3 dinners), AC transport as per group size, transfers to Barsheni and Tosh, a bonfire with light music and a tour curator.

faqs.q: How long is the Kheerganga trek?
faqs.a: 12 km with a moderate difficulty level, starting from Barsheni on Day 2. You trek back down to Barsheni on Day 3 after a night in camps. Kheerganga nights are cold, so pack warm.
Night 1 is in Kasol, night 2 in camps at Kheerganga and night 3 in a guest house in Tosh village. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
